title: 街頭自転車修理スタンド
description: 支持アーム、ワイヤーでつながれた工具、手動空気入れとホースを備える修理スタンド。自転車は含みません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。
descriptionEn: A public bicycle service post with support cradle, tethered generic tools, hand pump, hose and mechanical gauge; no bicycle included. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing.
author: Xenoah
uv: Original UV coordinates and split normals retained. Tangents are not exported; calculate them in the receiving application.
descriptionScope: Original model purpose and source-format notes; FBX-specific facts and differences are in CONVERSION.json and CONVERSION_NOTES.md.
